name: EPIC 245965617
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 18.4 solar radii and 0.78 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,033 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.78 solar masses and 18.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,779 K at its surface.
